description:
## Goal

Make `ProductMemo` the sole authority for settled artifact products and delete parallel typed artifact inventories from `PullSession`.

## Evidence

`PullSession` stores materialized, effect, ABI, backend, and executable-index maps in parallel with the memo. Producers clone values into these side maps. Most reads are inventory or tests; typed iteration over settled memo keys and values can answer the same questions. Parallel storage increases memory, clone work, invalidation surface, and the chance that two stores disagree.

## Strategy and proof

1. Inventory every side-map producer and consumer and classify the semantic question it asks.
2. Add typed memo iteration/query APIs only for live questions.
3. Move production consumers and assertions to memo-owned products.
4. Prove identical materialized activation set, executable index, settled-key set, product generations, root artifact, and telemetry.
5. Delete `materialized_executables`, effect inventory, `abi_executables`, `backend_executables`, `executable_index`, record APIs, invalidation code made unreachable, and transition-only tests.
6. Run full product tests, library, fixture matrix, determinism, formatting, and clippy with warnings denied.

No compatibility mirror remains.
title: Delete PullSession's parallel artifact side maps
